explanation.text: The Logic: Vega measures the sensitivity of the option price to changes in the implied volatility of the underlying (workbook page 78). It is expressed as Vega = Change in Option Price / Change in Volatility, i.e. how much the option premium changes when implied volatility changes. The Trap: The other Greeks measure different sensitivities — Theta captures time decay, Delta captures sensitivity to the underlying's price, and Gamma captures the rate of change of Delta. Vega is specifically about volatility. Note: Because Vega changes with implied volatility, options can become more or less sensitive to volatility shifts as market conditions move.
